entities.name: Ertai
entities.description: Wizard who trained under Barrin of Tolaria and serves as the Weatherlight's 'resident' wizard.

entities.name: Gerrard Capashen
entities.description: Soldier and adventurer, heir to the Legacy, captain of the Weatherlight in Sisay's absence.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Silver golem part of the Legacy, haunted by having accidentally killed while protecting the young Gerrard.

entities.name: Maraxus
entities.description: A chaotic warlord of Keld who serves as a hired killer for Volrath.

entities.name: Mirri
entities.description: A fierce, agile warrior who trained under Multani and is Gerrard's unofficial first mate.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: Former captain of the Weatherlight who quested for the Legacy.

entities.name: Squee
entities.description: The Weatherlight's goblin cabin boy.

entities.name: Tahngarth
entities.description: A narcissistic minotaur, first mate of the Weatherlight under Sisay.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: An old, powerful wizard of Tolaria who trained Ertai and is Hanna's father.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: A wealthy cursed noble who joins the Weatherlight crew and seeks Selenia.

entities.name: Greven il-Vec
entities.description: A ruthless leader for Volrath who commands the flying ship Predator.

entities.name: Hanna
entities.description: Expert navigator of the Weatherlight, educated in Argive.

entities.name: Orim
entities.description: Samite healer aboard the Weatherlight who keeps a diary.

entities.name: Selenia
entities.description: An angel and former guardian of Crovax's estate who now serves Volrath in Rath.

entities.name: Starke
entities.description: A former merchant of Rath who switches sides and accompanies the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: Son of Sidar Kondo who stole Gerrard's Legacy and became an evincar of the Lord of the Wastes.

entities.name: Eladamri
entities.description: Proud, charismatic leader waging guerrilla war against Volrath for the Skyshroud elves.

entities.name: Lyna
entities.description: A Soltari emissary who can cross the shadow barrier.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: A forest spirit and maro-sorcerer who mentors apprentice mages.

entities.name: Oracle
entities.description: A prophet who believes Gerrard to be the Korvecdal.

entities.name: Rofellos
entities.description: Gerrard's friend and fellow student under Multani.

entities.name: Sidar Kondo
entities.description: Guardian of the infant Gerrard who raised him alongside his son Vuel.

entities.name: Vuel
entities.description: Sidar Kondo's bitter son, who became a force of malice.

entities.name: Sliver Queen, Brood Mother
entities.description: A sliver queen held captive beneath Volrath's stronghold whose litters range across Rath.

entities.name: Takara
entities.description: A warrior who refuses Starke's path of self-interest.

entities.name: Ashnod
entities.description: Mishra's confidante in Fallaji weapons development who works in living flesh.

entities.name: Gix
entities.description: Phyrexian praetor who rose through ruthlessness and ambition.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Urza's younger brother and artificer whose strength gave rise to Phyrexian war engines on Dominaria.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: A planeswalker embodying white mana, named for a benevolent goddess.

entities.name: Tawnos
entities.description: An artificer promoted from apprentice to master in Urza's studio.

entities.name: Titania
entities.description: Voice and aspect of the Argoth forest.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: An artificer of unparalleled renown and planeswalker.

entities.name: Xantcha
entities.description: A Phyrexian sleeper agent rescued by Urza.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: A flying ship whose crew opposes the Lord of the Wastes.

entities.name: Predator
entities.description: A flying ship commanded by Greven il-Vec for Volrath.

entities.name: Legacy
entities.description: A collection of artifacts needed to defeat the Lord of the Wastes, of which Gerrard is heir.

entities.name: Lord of the Wastes
entities.description: A foe the Weatherlight crew battles, served by Volrath.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: Home realm of Volrath, Selenia and Starke, from which refugees flee.

entities.name: Tolaria
entities.description: The mysterious isle where Barrin lives.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane Gerrard traveled and where Phyrexian war engines first appeared.

entities.name: Keld
entities.description: Home of warlords including Maraxus.

entities.name: Skyshroud elves
entities.description: Elves Eladamri seeks to liberate.

entities.name: Soltari
entities.description: Shadow-dwelling people whose emissary is Lyna.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: Realm ruled by a regime where the weak become fodder for the strong.

entities.name: Argoth
entities.description: Forest whose health is tied to Titania.

entities.name: Fallaji
entities.description: People for whom Mishra led weapons development.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: The war between Urza and Mishra that brought Dominaria to the point of annihilation.

entities.name: Benalish army
entities.description: An army in which Gerrard served nobly.

events.summary: Gerrard returns to the Weatherlight as captain in Sisay's absence after serving in the Benalish army.
events.quote: Now, after serving nobly in the Benalish army, he has returned to the *Weatherlight* to serve as captain in Sisay's absence

events.summary: Karn accidentally takes a life while protecting the young Gerrard and vows never to kill again.
events.quote: Karn accidentally took the life of another.

events.summary: Mirri rejoins Gerrard aboard the Weatherlight as his unofficial first mate.
events.quote: she rejoined Gerrard aboard the *Weatherlight* as his unofficial first mate

events.summary: Sisay undertakes a quest for the Legacy and continues it when Gerrard abandons it.
events.quote: She continued this quest even when Gerrard, heir to the Legacy, chose to abandon it.

events.summary: Crovax joins the Weatherlight crew to rescue their abducted captain Sisay.
events.quote: joining the crew of the *Weatherlight* as they seek to rescue their abducted captain Sisay.

events.summary: Crovax freed Selenia from her magical bindings; she chose to leave him.
events.quote: Selenia was freed from her magical bindings by the wealthy noble.

events.summary: Selenia now serves Volrath in Rath.
events.quote: Selenia now serves the evil Volrath in his home realm of Rath.

events.summary: Volrath stole Gerrard's Legacy and sold it off piece by piece.
events.quote: Volrath stole Gerrard's Legacy and rose to power selling it off piece by piece.

events.summary: Volrath becomes an evincar of the Lord of the Wastes.
events.quote: Now, he is an evincar, or agent, of the Lord of the Wastes.

events.summary: Greven il-Vec rises through schemes and assassinations blessed by Volrath.
events.quote: Greven has attained his powerful rank through a series of underhanded schemes and assassinations

events.summary: Eladamri wages guerrilla war against Volrath.
events.quote: The guerilla war he wages against Volrath

events.summary: Multani taught Gerrard, Mirri and Rofellos to hone spellcasting alongside physical discipline.
events.quote: Multani taught Gerrard, Mirri, and Rofellos to hone their spellcasting in tandem with more physical disciplines

events.summary: Oracle believes Gerrard to be the Korvecdal.
events.quote: She believes Gerrard to be the *Korvecdal*, the one who will unite the people of Rath against Volrath's tyranny.

events.summary: Sidar Kondo raised Gerrard alongside his son Vuel, who became malicious.
events.quote: Vuel's bitterness led him to become an equally devastating force of malice.

events.summary: The sliver queen is held captive beneath Volrath's stronghold.
events.quote: Though long held captive beneath Volrath's stronghold, the sliver queen is actually freer than most of Rath's denizens.

events.summary: Ashnod served as Mishra's confidante in Fallaji weapons development.
events.quote: Ashnod served as Mishra's confidante while he led Fallaji weapons development before the Brothers' War.

events.summary: Gix rises to the rank of praetor in the Phyrexian regime.
events.quote: Gix rose through the Phyrexian regime to the exalted rank of praetor.

events.summary: Mishra's strength gave rise to Phyrexian war engines on Dominaria and his weakness pushed Dominaria toward annihilation.
events.quote: It was Mishra's strength that first gave rise to the massive Phyrexian war engines on Dominaria

events.summary: Serra fulfilled the prophecy of the goddess for whom she was named.
events.quote: Serra fulfilled the prophecy of that goddess's coming.

events.summary: Tawnos is promoted from apprentice to master artificer.
events.quote: His speed and flexibility quickly earned him promotion from apprentice to master artificer.

events.summary: Xantcha is sentenced to death by Phyrexia but rescued by Urza.
events.quote: she was rescued by Urza and joined his crusade.

events.summary: Barrin trained the young Ertai.
events.quote: Barrin is the teacher who trained the young Ertai.
